build_entity_prefab: build an Entity prefab with a name, goal, and custom instructions for a Concordia agent
build_entity_with_goal: build an Entity prefab that includes an overarching goal component for the agent
build_entity_with_extra_components: build an Entity prefab with extra components inserted at specific indices in the component order
build_entity_with_custom_instructions: build an Entity prefab using custom instructions instead of default ones for the agent
build_entity_with_randomized_choices: build an Entity prefab with randomized choices enabled for agent decision making
